patchNotes: Reworked Disable Trick Tweaking to block manual and automatic bike tweaks. Added Game, Disabled, and Swap Sides controls for nose-manual Hang 5 variants. Added optional manual and nose-manual pose editing: move and rotate each foot and the hips with larger in-game handles and wider adjustment ranges. Load custom rider animation clips from Unity bundles and assign them in the trick editor. Added a 30-250 Hz physics update setting that keeps the game's own rate by default; higher rates use more CPU. Added VX1000 film grain, lens dirt, and fine scratches for replays. Improved landing-assist controls, vehicle-tuning toggles, and grind-pose scrolling. Reworked startup safety to avoid the earlier tweak-related map-spawn failure and keep unsupported controls inactive on unverified game builds. Removed the custom-frame rear-peg workaround because that issue belongs to the base game. Testing note: the newest nose-manual, pose, and startup changes still need broader in-game testing.
